Paragraph: On hearing Hanuma's words Sugreeva, the chief of monkeys has become presentable and gladly spoke to Rama.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Overcoming initial fury and mistrust to engage peacefully.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva calms down, regains his composure, and addresses Rama with gladness.
Outcome/Resolution: Anxiety and hostility are replaced by cordiality.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Calming down and regaining regal composure

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sugreeva sheds his defensive anger (krodha) upon receiving reassuring truth.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Successful emotional de-escalation leading to open, pro-social behavior.
